final.summary: ETP power stayed within the expected band for inflow and meter photos match the digital feed. ETP inflow was normal, equalization tank level was stable, outfall pH remained near neutral throughout the treatment interval, and an accredited lab grab at 13/10/2026 14:30 shows BOD 13.1 mg/L with pH 7.47. Outfall flow is missing from 2026-10-13 10:30 to 2026-10-14 02:10 and outfall conductivity drops from the 5700s to the 3700s around 12:30-19:10, suggesting possible groundwater dilution at the outfall. Tank water balance shows 212.3 m³ unaccounted for, outside tolerance.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
